# Freshcoat Painting

> Professional painting services in Christchurch, New Zealand. Interior, exterior, roof and commercial painting with a 5-year workmanship guarantee, backed by 30+ years of experience.

Freshcoat Painting is a Christchurch-based painting contractor serving residential and commercial customers across Canterbury. We use premium paint brands (Resene, Dulux, Wattyl) and offer free, no-obligation quotes. Contact: michael@freshcoat.co.nz, 022 0366586.
